pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: The right anterior shoulder features polygonal patches with sharp edge gradients. The posterior flank displays more irregular, elongated patches with smoother, lower-contrast pixel transitions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light cream pelage separates the patches. Nodes at intersections are clearly visible on the shoulder, where corridors have a narrower pixel width than the broader pathways on the posterior flank.

other_distinctive_markers: Localized dark pigmentation is concentrated on the distal muzzle and surrounding the nostrils.
